22491.commentary: (PMa) kummaggappaṭipanno'ti kucchitaṃ micchāmaggaṃ paṭipanno. upari pana vipathapakkhando'ti nānāpadehi visesetvā vuttaṃ.

examples.text: kummaggappaṭipanno so, mohaneyyesu mucchito, abhabbo tādiso bhikkhu, phuṭṭhuṃ sambodhim'uttamaṃ.
cātumahābhūtiko mātāpettika-sambhavo odana-kummāsa-upacayo anicc'ucchādana-parimaddana-bhedana-viddhaṃsana-dhammo, idañ'ca pana me viññāṇaṃ ettha sitaṃ ettha paṭibaddhan'ti
bhojanīyaṃ nāma pañca bhojanāni, odano, kummāso, sattu, maccho, maṃsaṃ.

22495.meaningLit: discourse on the simile of the turtle

22496.commentary: (SNa) doṇapākakuran'ti doṇapākaṃ kuraṃ, doṇassa taṇḍulānaṃ pakkabhattaṃ tadūpiyañ'ca sūpabyañjanaṃ bhuñjatī'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena rājā pasenadi kosalo doṇapākakuraṃ bhuñjati. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhuttāvī mah'assāsī yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare papāte pabbate. atha kho hāliddikāni gahapati yen'āyasmā mahākaccāno ten'upasaṅkami
